name: splotch
description: Splotch is a drawing app for toddlers, built with React Native for web, Android, and iOS.

scripts.check: tsc --project tsconfig.shared.json && npm run check:netlify && npm run check:migration:types && npm run check:e2e
scripts.test: npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:asset-gen && npm run test:store-drawings && npm run test:tools && npm run test:migration:rsd-selection && npm run test:e2e
scripts.perf:centerline-tracing: uv run --project tools/centerline-tracing --locked python -m centerline_tracing.pipeline.bench all --width-mode piecewise
scripts.test:centerline-tracing: uv run --project tools/centerline-tracing --locked ruff check tools/centerline-tracing/src tools/centerline-tracing/tests && uv run --project tools/centerline-tracing --locked pytest -m 'not integration' && vitest run --config tools/centerline-tracing/vitest.config.mjs
scripts.prerelease: npm run check:coloring-assets && npm run check:assets:manifest

scripts-info.info: Lists every npm script with its description (this output)
scripts-info.build:site: The Netlify deploy build: native:web:build's export (the React Native web app's documents, worker, and the files the host serves beside them from assets/static) and its browserless checks (the precache, every document's policy, and the per-document byte budgets). The Chromium checks of postnative:web:build need Playwright, which Netlify's --prod install leaves out, so CI runs them
scripts-info.check: Type-check the shared TypeScript, Netlify Function, React Native app and web E2E projects
scripts-info.check:netlify: Type-check custom Netlify functions with their standalone TypeScript project
scripts-info.check:e2e: Type-check the RN web E2E suite (e2e/) with its own TypeScript project; Playwright and Node's type stripping run it unchecked
scripts-info.check:adrs: Fails when docs/adrs/ identity or index invariants drift: unique numbers across this tree and its base, matching H1s, exactly one canonical index entry per record, and matching labels and targets for every local ADR link; run by the ADR Integrity workflow on every PR (pass --base=<ref>; defaults to origin/main)
scripts-info.check:coloring-assets: Validate the coloring-book catalog against assets/static: every catalog asset exists, no coloring asset is unreferenced, no book is both mobile-eligible and stripped as web-only, and no Markdown sits in the publicly served tree. Auto-runs before release; also run against the real tree by npm run test:tools, so CI checks it on every PR
scripts-info.check:assets:manifest: CI guard for gen:assets:manifest: fail if any committed art asset's bytes drifted from tools/asset-gen/golden/asset-manifest.sha256 (e.g. a night pass touched a light file); run gen:assets:manifest and commit to fix
scripts-info.check:ideas-review: CI drift guard for the committed tools/asset-gen/ideas-exploration/ideas-review.html dashboard; regenerate it with node tools/asset-gen/ideas-exploration/build-review.mjs and commit the result
scripts-info.check:svg-assets: CI guard for optimize:svg-assets: fail if any SVG under assets/ is not already optimized (run optimize:svg-assets and commit to fix)
scripts-info.optimize:svg-assets: Optimize every shipped/inlined SVG under assets/ in place with SVGO (visually-lossless preset; keeps viewBox). Idempotent — re-running only rewrites new/edited SVGs
scripts-info.check:quality: Run CI's Quality job locally, in its order — format, shared, Netlify, RN and E2E type checks, lint, the drift guards, the token ratchet, dead code, the asset manifest, the scrapbook index, and the dependency audit. Unlike CI it keeps going after a failure, so one run surfaces every problem instead of one per push; test:browserless mirrors the Browserless tests job. tools/ci-mirror/tests/run-quality-checks.test.mjs fails if this list drifts from the workflow
scripts-info.check:github-actions: Report the GitHub Actions version pins across .github/workflows and flag drift; add --check-latest to compare each against its latest upstream release (network)
scripts-info.check:skill-refs: Fail when shared prose spells a skill with a runner-specific sigil — Claude Code's /name or Codex's $name — instead of naming it bare; runner-owned trees and the historical records are exempt. Also run as a test by npm run test:tools
scripts-info.check:doc-refs: Fail when a living doc, skill, or rule names a repo path or npm script that no longer resolves; history records, skill notes, and generated copies are exempt, gitignored paths pass, and ALLOWED_REFERENCES holds the deliberate exceptions. -- --identifiers also lists code identifiers no tracked source names (advisory, for the reconcile-docs-with-code skill). Also run as a test by npm run test:tools
scripts-info.check:agent-memories: Read-only check of a supplied Claude project memory directory: index, wiki links, missing frontmatter names, and npm scripts fail on drift; display names, unscanned entries, repo paths, possible skill names, and flags print for human review. Pass -- --memory-dir=<path>; the external memory is not in CI
scripts-info.report:app-size: Store download size and on-device install size for shipping vs RN on Android (bundletool, Galaxy spec) and iOS (Xcode app thinning, iPad13,8 on iPadOS 26.5) from release artifacts: -- --android-shipping=<aab> --android-rn=<aab> --ios-shipping=<xcarchive> --ios-rn=<xcarchive>
scripts-info.report:browser-floor: Read-only evidence for the audit-compatibility skill: global usage the browser floor reaches vs Baseline Widely Available, every runtime feature probe in shipped src with whether the risk register cites it, and -- --feature <web-features id> lookups against the floor
scripts-info.show:pr-state: Read-only PR snapshot from gh: current head, merge metadata, registered checks, and paginated review threads; -- <number> [--repo owner/name] [--json]. Check expected CI registration separately
scripts-info.show:epic-children: Read-only inventory of an epic's nested GitHub sub-issues, with per-parent and unique counts; -- <number> [--repo owner/name] [--json]. Read comments before classifying children
scripts-info.show:free-port: Print one currently free local TCP port without stopping any listener; -- [--from 5300] [--to 5399] [--host localhost]. Retry on EADDRINUSE when starting the server
scripts-info.check:coloring-pack-retention: Fail when assets/static no longer serves, byte-identically, a coloring-pack file some released native app downloads by manifest path + SHA-256 (ADR-0103); reads the committed tools/release/coloring-pack-snapshots/ and prints per-release unserved/blocked counts. Every pack-shipping release is listed with its exact unserved-file count in RELEASED_PACK_BROKEN_FILES (0 when healthy), so a lost snapshot also fails. Also run as a test by npm run test:tools
scripts-info.lint: ESLint over the repo scopes declared in eslint.config.js: React hooks, shared project conventions and scoped type-aware no-floating-promises
scripts-info.lint:css: Stylelint over every hand-authored .css file, excluding generated output through stylelint.config.js; adopted rules and measured rejected candidates are recorded in ADR-0031
scripts-info.lint:dead: Dead-code gate (knip): fails on unused files, exports, exported types, and duplicate exports across src, e2e, root configs, netlify, and the tools capabilities enumerated in knip.json — remove the symbol or tag a deliberate seam with /** @public */
scripts-info.lint:deps:prod: ADR-0070 dependency-split gate (knip --production --strict over knip.production.json): fails when code the Netlify deploy executes imports a package filed under devDependencies, which Netlify's --prod install omits, or when a dependencies entry is something the deploy never uses
scripts-info.format: Format the whole repo: Prettier for source and config files, dprint for markdown
scripts-info.format:check: Check Prettier + dprint formatting without writing — what CI runs
scripts-info.preformat:md: Checks this checkout's installed dprint plugins against the ranges in package.json, so a stale worktree install fails naming the version gap instead of a config option dprint cannot parse
scripts-info.format:md: Format all markdown docs with dprint (asterisk bullets/emphasis, wrap at 100, ADR-0057)
scripts-info.preformat:md:check: Checks this checkout's installed dprint plugins against the ranges in package.json, so a stale worktree install fails naming the version gap instead of a config option dprint cannot parse
scripts-info.format:md:check: Check markdown formatting without writing or a host cache — part of format:check
scripts-info.ruler:apply: Regenerate agent files from .ruler/ while preserving direct provider skill packages, apply managed skill forks, then dprint-format the committed output (ADR-0058)
scripts-info.ruler:check: CI drift guard for ruler:apply: re-apply and fail if generated agent output changed; excludes registered direct provider packages
scripts-info.ruler:dry-run: Preview what ruler:apply would regenerate without writing any files (note: skips the dprint fmt pass, so blank-line noise it reports may format away)
scripts-info.run-claude:install: Install the trusted rival-agent package (core + Codex-side launcher, poster, health probe) under ~/.local/libexec and the Codex prompt/deny policy; restart Codex afterward
scripts-info.run-claude:policy:check: Read-only preflight: verify Codex approval settings, the effective wrapper/raw-Claude rules, and every installed rival-agent byte
scripts-info.run-claude:installation:check: Read-only preflight: verify the installed rival-agent package and shims match the trusted canonical checkout
scripts-info.rival:health: Read-only preflight for the Codex rival: verify the Codex CLI is installed and logged in on the ChatGPT plan rather than API billing
scripts-info.rival:launch: Launch the Codex rival agent read-only in a disposable worktree with the broker attached; append --pr <n>, --base <ref>, --commit <sha>, or --uncommitted, plus --question-file or --prompt-file
scripts-info.rival:next: Handler side of the broker: block for the rival's next command request, or its finished findings; append --session <dir>
scripts-info.rival:reply: Handler side of the broker: answer one request with an exit code and captured output, or decline it; append --session <dir> --request <seq> …
scripts-info.rival:status: Summarize a rival session: pending requests, done or failed; append --session <dir>
scripts-info.rival:post: Post a finished rival session's findings to a PR as one COMMENT review with a hidden marker; append --pr <n> --session <dir>
scripts-info.rival:bench: Run the seeded-defect bench: one fresh rival round per seed, sandbox mode, and repetition on the corpus under tools/rival-agent/bench/seeds, the bench serving the broker; --validate proves every seed first. Manual, spends plan usage, never in CI
scripts-info.rival:seed: Laptop-side: sign in to Codex under a dedicated ~/.codex-cloud login and copy the CODEX_AUTH_JSON seed for the Claude cloud environment dialog to the clipboard, so cloud sessions can run the Codex rival on the ChatGPT plan; repeat once a cloud review has refreshed and rotated the previous seed
scripts-info.gen:rival-acceptance: Generate a nonce-bearing manual real-agent communication question under the temp root; never runs in CI
scripts-info.stack:push:rebased: Publish an intentional gh stack rebase, refusing to push when it changed the content of any PR another open PR is based on
scripts-info.test: Coverage-gated app unit + asset-pipeline + store-drawing + repo-script + RSD native-renderer unit (Vitest) + RN web E2E (Playwright) — what CI runs on every push
scripts-info.gen:flaky-digest: Harvest flaky.json records from the Tests workflow's Playwright report artifacts into a rolling history (starting from the latest flaky-digest-history artifact, or -- --fresh) and rank masked flakes per test with run/attempt/branch/shard provenance and named coverage gaps, written to test-results/flaky-digest/. Needs GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, or gh auth
scripts-info.gen:code-map: Regenerate the tables in docs/CODE-MAP.md (lines of code per area and src domain) from one commit's tree, read from git so a ref always regenerates identically; the prose around them belongs to the reconcile-code-map skill. Flags: --ref <rev> (default HEAD), --assignments (print every tracked path's placement and line count as TSV instead of writing)
scripts-info.perf:centerline-tracing: Run the opt-in centerline tracer's full synthetic corpus and committed-input benchmark through the locked uv environment; refreshes numeric records for human regression review
scripts-info.test:unit: Run the framework-free shared unit tests
scripts-info.test:unit:coverage: Run the framework-free shared unit tests with coverage
scripts-info.test:unit:watch: Run the framework-free shared unit tests in watch mode
scripts-info.test:browserless: Run CI's Browserless tests job locally, in its order — coverage-gated app unit, asset-pipeline, store-drawing, repo-script, and RSD native-renderer Vitest tiers, then the API contract smoke (SMOKE_PORT picks its port). No Playwright, unlike npm test. Unlike CI it keeps going after a failure, so one run surfaces every problem. tools/ci-mirror/tests/run-browserless-tests.test.mjs fails if this list drifts from the workflow
scripts-info.test:asset-gen: Asset-gen pipeline tests (Vitest, Node env): image-analysis helpers against committed fixtures plus mocked generator CLI workflows — no Gemini/network
scripts-info.test:store-drawings: Store-drawing pipeline tests (Vitest, Node env, tools/store-drawings/tests/): SVG subset parsing, static instruction generation, scene fitting, and generated-module drift
scripts-info.test:centerline-tracing: Opt-in locked Python and Node bridge checks for tools/centerline-tracing; deliberately excluded from aggregate npm test
scripts-info.test:tools: Repo-automation script tests (Vitest, Node env, tools/tests/): audit-burndown state/runner seams, complete Ruler skill-fork replacement, the Android emulator API-level drift invariants (local literals match CURRENT_ANDROID_API_LEVEL and the deploy matrix adds the declared floor), the throwaway-server env guard (both test servers must declare every private env var src reads instead of inheriting local credentials), and one live case that boots an owned logging server to prove a released child outlives its caller
scripts-info.test:e2e: Playwright against the React Native web export, served as Netlify serves it (e2e/README.md): every spec in Chromium, the @smoke specs in Firefox and WebKit where installed. Builds the export first unless SPLOTCH_E2E_PREBUILT is set; SPLOTCH_E2E_PORT picks the port
scripts-info.test:e2e:headed: Playwright with browser visible, slowed down (SLOWMO=500)
scripts-info.test:android: React Native Android smoke test, self-contained: builds the .dev Release APK, boots a headless emulator, installs, runs the Maestro boot check against .dev, tears down
scripts-info.test:android:device: Maestro smoke flow against the store-identity app (art.splotch.app) already installed on a running emulator or simulator (what the Android deploy workflow uses)
scripts-info.test:ios: React Native iOS smoke test, self-contained: builds the store-identity Release simulator app, boots an iPhone simulator no one else booted, installs, runs Maestro, tears down; --skip-build installs the app ios:simulator already built (macOS-only)
scripts-info.test:api:smoke: API contract smoke test, self-contained: serves the /api function on a throwaway plain Node host (no SvelteKit, no vite dev) with test env, exercises the CORS/preflight contract + the admin auth flow + a public oracle against the documented /api/* shapes, tears down (no Gemini/Blobs needed)
scripts-info.test:deploy:smoke: Hosted deploy contract: static routes, headers, version freshness, native CORS, safe API failures, and persistent Blobs (read-only on production; preview adds a write round-trip) (DEPLOY_SMOKE_URL + ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN)
scripts-info.test:blobs:smoke: Deploy smoke test (ADR-0025): against a real Netlify deploy (BLOBS_SMOKE_URL + ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN), asserts persistent:true without mutating production; previews also round-trip and clean up a token
scripts-info.test:lighthouse:ci: Build the React Native web export (build:site) and run the committed page-load gate against it, served as Netlify serves it: median of three simulated Slow 4G + 4x CPU Lighthouse runs for phone portrait/tablet landscape x first/repeat visit; FCP/LCP gate against the current baseline while TBT/CLS/score report only (-- --port=N --samples=odd>=3 --no-build --report-only --out=DIR --baseline=FILE; --no-build times the export already on disk)
scripts-info.test:firefox:smoke: Run the RN web E2E suite's @smoke specs in Firefox (needs the Firefox browser)
scripts-info.test:webkit:smoke: Run the RN web E2E suite's @smoke specs in WebKit (needs the WebKit browser)
scripts-info.fetch:image-reports: Read-only production AI-report fetch: resolve splotch.art through the authenticated Netlify CLI, snapshot complete ai-image-reports bundles under .eval-tmp/ai-image-reports/<timestamp>, manifest per-report failures without blocking other bundles, and first delete local snapshot folders plus report__ model-eval inputs and the images and result rows made from them past the AI-report retention window. Pass -- --import-eval-inputs to deliberately copy PNG drawings into the gitignored model-eval corpus. Makes no Gemini calls and never modifies production
scripts-info.redteam: MANUAL AI-safety red-team (ADR-0023): boots a throwaway plain Node function host, decrypts the corpus, flattens each safe-*/block-* drawing onto the app paper the way the real canvas export does, sends it to a real model call, and writes an HTML input->output report to tools/redteam/output/ for human review (opens in your browser). Pass ids to run a subset (npm run redteam -- block-gun) to iterate on one drawing. Real OPENAI_API_KEY + REDTEAM_FIXTURE_KEY required; excluded from npm test by design
scripts-info.redteam:encrypt: Encrypt tools/redteam/source/*.png -> tools/redteam/encrypted/*.enc (commit the .enc); needs REDTEAM_FIXTURE_KEY
scripts-info.model-eval: MANUAL paid image-model bake-off: compares selected model/quality variants over tools/model-eval/inputs/ using the production prompt and safety orchestrator, with a quality/cost/latency report under tools/model-eval/output/<runId>/report/. Requires keys for selected providers (OPENAI_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY); excluded from npm test. Env: VARIANTS (exact key/model first, otherwise substring; comma-separated exact keys), PER_CATEGORY, SAMPLES, FILTER, CONCURRENCY, OUT_TAG, SKIP_REPORT; RESUME=<run dir> keeps completed images only when recorded settings match; REPORT_FROM=<run dir> (+ VERDICT_FILE) rebuilds without API calls
scripts-info.model-eval:fixtures: Regenerate tools/model-eval/inputs/ — the deterministic fixtures plus every committed sample in samples/. Env: FILTER, DEBUG_SAMPLE. Rewrites only the inputs it produces itself and reports the rest, so paid output from model-eval:gen-inputs survive until they are promoted into samples/
scripts-info.model-eval:gen-inputs: Author canvas-plausible input drawings for the eval corpus (line/gen/scribble/mess categories) with gpt-image-2, or AUTHOR=gemini; ONLY=<substr[,substr]> selects a subset. Needs the chosen author's API key
scripts-info.model-eval:adherence: MANUAL prompt-adherence lab: holds gpt-image-2 low fixed and compares generate-image prompt variants (and image-tool knobs) by how faithfully outputs keep the child's composition, scored by tools/model-eval/lib/composition-score.mjs, writing a promotable report/ per run. Real OPENAI_API_KEY required; excluded from npm test. Env: LABS (exact keys), INPUTS/FILTER, SAMPLES, CONCURRENCY, OUT_TAG; REPORT_FROM=<run dir> rebuilds report/ with no API calls
scripts-info.gen:sound-effect: Generate one or a restart-safe JSON batch of sound effects through ElevenLabs' sound-generation-only API (-- --text ... --duration N --out FILE, or --input FILE --out-dir DIR). Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; --dry-run makes no API call
scripts-info.gen:pencil-sounds: Re-encode the stereo pencil masters in tools/sounds/masters into the mono clips assets/static/sounds serves, verifying each is mono with the master's sample rate and gapless loop length; prints bytes and decoded AudioBuffer size per clip. Needs the lame CLI on PATH
scripts-info.vectorize: Trace a bitmap to SVG/PDF/EPS/DXF/PNG through Vectorizer.AI (-- <input> --out file …). Defaults to the free watermarked test mode; --production spends 1 metered credit. Needs VECTORIZER_ID + VECTORIZER_SECRET — see tools/vectorize/README.md
scripts-info.vectorize:coloring: Plan or run restart-safe, paid light/dark coloring-outline SVG batches through Vectorizer.AI (-- --theme=dark --book=creatures --batch-size=12 --production); existing raw responses resume without another trace, --force explicitly re-traces stale derivations, and --write-ledger records source/output hashes
scripts-info.vectorize:coloring:analyze: Rasterize generated light/dark SVGs against their staged authoring sources, fail below the campaign fidelity thresholds, and report raw/gzip SVG bytes versus those WebPs (-- --theme=dark --book=creatures --match=cover)
scripts-info.vectorize:coloring:check: CI drift guard for every committed coloring-outline derivation ledger: source and light/dark SVG hashes and byte counts must remain exact
scripts-info.vectorize:postprocess: Optimize Vectorizer.AI SVG output and restore width/height from viewBox (-- input.svg --out output.svg; no input normalizes committed vector art in place)
scripts-info.vectorize:postprocess:check: CI drift guard for committed Vectorizer.AI SVGs: require byte-stable SVGO output and width/height matching viewBox
scripts-info.gen:icon-names: Generate tools/icons/lib/icon-names.d.ts from the startup and deferred SVGs under assets/icons/
scripts-info.gen:icon-viewbox: Rebase assets/icons/**/*.svg onto the canonical square viewBox with pixel verification; run optimize:svg-assets after. Optional: -- <icon-name> ...
scripts-info.gen:releases: Generate in-app/current/full release notes + fastlane store changelogs from releases/*.md (auto-runs before build)
scripts-info.gen:coloring-pack-snapshot: Reconstruct a historical pack-shipping tag's download inventory with that tag's own manifest generator and static tree (-- --ref v1.6.0); not a step for RN release tags
scripts-info.gen:share-cards: Generate the four standalone-page link-preview PNGs and content hashes from self-contained share-card documents (tools/marketing-assets/lib/share-card-document.mjs), rendered in Chromium with no server
scripts-info.gen:centerlines: Trace an explicit filled SVG file/directory into an explicit centerline SVG file/directory through the isolated locked uv project; requires --input and --output
scripts-info.gen:store-drawings: Generate deterministic static scene data from the maintained drawing instructions
scripts-info.gen:store-drawings:check: Fail when tools/store-drawings/generated/store-drawings.mjs differs from a fresh SVG-to-pointer-instructions conversion
scripts-info.gen:style-covers: Regenerate the AI style thumbnails in assets/static/styles/ from tools/asset-gen/style-covers/source.svg via Gemini (needs GEMINI_API_KEY; -- --style X --temperature N for one style / different takes)
scripts-info.gen:coloring-chalk: Generate a page or cover's CHALK line art from its pen via Gemini — --apply stages an uncommitted dark SVG trace source; solid-white eye whites/catchlights, gated on registration + regional chalk-vs-pen ink checks; candidates land in .coloring-samples-dark/chalk/ (needs GEMINI_API_KEY; -- page-or-category… or book/cover [--apply] [--max-attempts N] [-t F] [--notes "…"] [--force]; --rescore re-gates saved candidates offline)
scripts-info.gen:coloring-fills: Generate gated flat-color LIGHT fill candidates via Gemini into .coloring-samples/; --rescore [--sample N] --apply ships the selected reviewed bytes only when every requested page passes outline keep, local warp, white, and eye gates, otherwise committed raw/punched assets stay unchanged (model runs need GEMINI_API_KEY; -- page-or-category [--rescore] [--sample N] [--apply] [--samples N] [--temperature N] [--warp-max N] [--notes TEXT])
scripts-info.check:coloring-fill-drift: Audit both themes' committed raw fills (tools/asset-gen/fill-src/) for registration vs their line art: light global/worst-tile keep plus per-tile local warp with residual global shift reported separately; flags any that need regenerating. No API key/network (-- page-or-category, --warp-max N, --overlay to dump light drift maps)
scripts-info.check:coloring-fill-eyes: Audit the committed fills' EYES — gates ringed light pupils on raw-fill contrast (source-solid pupils are owned by the pen overlay and report n/a), plus night contrast and a final-composite `orb` check for blank white pupils. Deterministic, no API key/network (-- page-or-category… to filter)
scripts-info.gen:coloring-eye-review: Build a self-contained HTML review of every BLANK-ORB-flagged night eye (the `orb` column of check:coloring-fill-eyes) — whole-page composite + zoomed eye crops with median/white — to publish with the Artifact tool and triage real defects vs over-flags before burning them down. Deterministic, no API key/network (-- page-or-category…, --out FILE)
scripts-info.check:coloring-invented-shapes: Audit the committed raw fills for INVENTED COLORED SHAPES floating on the open background (extra stars/flowers no drift/white/eye gate can see; anchoring to source lines or the border is the discriminator). Deterministic, no API key/network (-- page-or-category…[.light|.night], --verbose, --overlay to dump detection maps)
scripts-info.check:coloring-night-halo: Audit every shipped night fill for RESIDUAL DARK HALO around the chalk strokes after the punch: normalized haloScore shows the automatic new-candidate bar, while rawScore separately flags human crop review. Deterministic, no API key/network (-- page-or-category… to filter, --out FILE for per-page JSON to diff across punch changes)
scripts-info.check:coloring-outline-quality: Audit shipped line art for solid black regions, over-ringed eyes, and page frames (continuous four-sided ink or page-spanning near-white ghost lines). Deterministic, no API key/network (-- page-or-category… to filter)
scripts-info.gen:coloring-outlines:fresh: Author a BRAND-NEW pen outline for a page from a text scene description (no conditioning on the old drawing) via Gemini, gated on solidity/ring-depth/eye-cores/outer whitespace/page frames/ink; candidates land in .coloring-samples/fresh/ (needs GEMINI_API_KEY; -- page --scene "…" [--eyes] [--apply] [--max-attempts N] [-t F] [--notes "…"])
scripts-info.gen:coloring-outlines:normalize: Redraw an outline's solid black regions as thin outlined strokes via Gemini, gated on solidity + outline registration; candidates land in .coloring-samples-dark/normalize/ (needs GEMINI_API_KEY; -- page… [--apply] [--max-attempts N] [-t F] [--notes "…"])
scripts-info.update:coloring-golden-scores: Freeze every offline audit score for the whole coloring catalog (outline solidity/eye rings/page frames, light keep/localKeep + eyes, both themes' local warp/residual shift, night drift/bgLuma/lineWhite + eyes/blank-orbs) into tools/asset-gen/golden/golden-scores.json — the committed regression baseline. Deterministic, no API key/network (~2 min)
scripts-info.check:coloring-golden-scores: Re-run every offline audit and diff against golden/golden-scores.json: verdict flips (including composite blank-orbs) and bad-direction score movements = regressions (exit 1); improvements/moves reported. Run after any pipeline or asset change; update the baseline to adopt intended changes. No API key/network (~1 min)
scripts-info.gen:coloring-punched-fills: Re-derive the shipped fills-only .light/.night.webp from the raw fills in tools/asset-gen/fill-src/ by punching their outlines out (line art as mask). Deterministic, no API key/network (-- page-or-category… to filter)
scripts-info.gen:coloring-responsive: Derive compact fills, cover thumbnails, and responsive alpha-preserving page-selector rasters; full-page art stays canonical SVG. Deterministic, no API key/network (-- category… to filter)
scripts-info.gen:coloring-thumbs: Regenerate the light/dark .thumb.webp cover thumbnails for the coloring-book picker (-- category… to filter)
scripts-info.gen:coloring-book-proof-sheet: Build a self-contained HTML proof sheet of ONE coloring category — line art, chalk, light + night fills side by side with outline-keep scores, plus the composited view — to review/publish as an Artifact (-- category[/page[-orient]], --source shipped|samples, --out FILE)
scripts-info.gen:e2e-tuning-report: Rebuild the E2E tuning scrapbook page (ADR-0059) from the worker-count measurements recorded in the script: the sweep tables, the local/CI comparison, and the flake hypotheses that were falsified. Edit the datasets at the top of tools/e2e-tuning/gen-tuning-report.mjs after a re-tune, then re-run. Deterministic, no network
scripts-info.review:page-inventory: Run one fresh image-only agent review per current page-inventory capture and write one hash-bound checkpoint per review ID, using whichever of claude or codex is installed (-- --runner claude|codex --concurrency N --limit N --review-id ID --model MODEL --effort LEVEL)
scripts-info.finalize:page-inventory-critique: Strictly merge independent page-inventory review checkpoints into a manifest-bound design-critique.json, deriving coverage + severity totals, recording every group of captures that share a digest and theme with whether their severities diverge, and refusing missing/stale reviews (-- --status lists the queue; --manifest FILE --checkpoints DIR --out FILE; --allow-partial requires a scratch --out)
scripts-info.gen:assets:manifest: Rewrite tools/asset-gen/golden/asset-manifest.sha256 (sha256 per committed art asset: coloring pages, style covers, AI value-prop tiles, fill-src raws) so binary asset changes review as text diffs; verified in CI by check:assets:manifest
scripts-info.gen:store-assets: Render store screenshots and feature graphic from committed captures at each store’s pixel sizes
scripts-info.gen:store-assets:frames: Render store screenshots and feature graphic from committed captures at each store’s pixel sizes
scripts-info.scrapbook:publish: Promote a keeper run output into the committed scrapbook/ tree and rebuild the index — copies a file or dir under scrapbook/<type>/<name> for a live GitHub Pages URL (ADR-0059). Usage: -- <source> <type>/<name>, e.g. -- lighthouse-reports lighthouse/latest
scripts-info.scrapbook:index: Rebuild scrapbook/index.html and the coloring-book proof-sheet hub from the current scrapbook/ tree — no copy
scripts-info.scrapbook:serve: Serve the committed scrapbook locally at http://127.0.0.1:4174
scripts-info.scrapbook:proof-sheet-hub: Rebuild scrapbook/coloring-book-proof-sheets/index.html from its shared chrome and category registry
scripts-info.scrapbook:check: Drift guard (CI): fail if any scrapbook/ collection dir has no reachable entry page, so the index's collection count always matches the cards it renders (md-only collections included)
scripts-info.scrapbook:clear-sound-sheet: Rebuild the drag-to-clear sound audition sheet from the clips committed under scrapbook/sound-design/clear-sound-contact-sheet/assets. Usage: -- --from <dir of new mp3s> --inline <standalone.html>
scripts-info.scrapbook:clear-sound-sheet:audit: Drive every option on the sound audition sheet through every scripted gesture in headless Chromium and fail on any that renders silence. Set CHROMIUM_PATH when Playwright has no browser download
scripts-info.android:setup: One-time emulator setup: installs the API 33 system image and creates the Pixel_7_Pro_API_33 AVD
scripts-info.android:apk: Release-optimized APK of the React Native app as art.splotch.app.dev, signed with the local debug key, to install beside the store copy for testing or device perf → android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/
scripts-info.android:apk:store: The Android deploy smoke's artifact: Release APK of the React Native app as art.splotch.app, signed with the key android/keystore.properties names (a throwaway key on the CI runner); never install it on a physical device → android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/
scripts-info.android:bundle: Store AAB of the React Native app (art.splotch.app, upload-key signed, jarsigner-verified) → android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/; needs android/keystore.properties
scripts-info.android:verify: Verify the release AAB's signature (expect 'jar verified')
scripts-info.ios:simulator: pod install + unsigned Release build of the React Native app for the iOS Simulator as art.splotch.app (ios/Store.xcconfig), for this Mac's architecture: what Native compile builds and the iOS deploy smoke installs → ios/build/simulator/Build/Products/Release-iphonesimulator/Splotch.app (macOS-only)
scripts-info.ios:archive: pod install + store archive of the React Native app (art.splotch.app via ios/Store.xcconfig, the team in its untracked local.xcconfig) → ios/build/Splotch.xcarchive (macOS-only)
scripts-info.ios:ipa: ios:archive + export the App Store .ipa → ios/build/ipa/Splotch.ipa (macOS-only; see the mobile guide)
scripts-info.adb:reverse: Forward the phone's port 5173 to the desktop dev server (re-run after each USB reconnect)
scripts-info.audit:preflight: Read-only go/no-go check before an unattended audit burndown: selected agent auth, clean tree, origin reachable, docs/AUDIT.md parses, npm run check green (burn-down-audits skill)
scripts-info.audit:burndown: Scripted burndown of docs/AUDIT.md: one isolated Claude/Codex session per role per finding (verify → implement → adversarial review → fix), one commit each, pushed every finding. MAX_ISSUES=5 canary by default; knobs are env vars — see the burn-down-audits skill
scripts-info.audit:burndown:overnight: Launch audit:burndown unattended (-- N findings, default 600): preflight-gated, spawned detached so a closed terminal can't kill it. Stop with `touch .audit-work/STOP`
scripts-info.audit:status: Where the audit burndown stands: completed/deferred/remaining counts, progress bar, run state, unposted PR comments, recent Audit: commits, last log lines
scripts-info.audit:cost: Audit-burndown usage from saved Claude JSON or Codex JSONL: cost/tokens by role, per-issue average, projected remaining total
scripts-info.audit:watch: Live view of a running audit burndown: tail -f the run log, or -- --dash for a status summary refreshing every 10s
scripts-info.release: Cut a release from releases/<version>.md: bump versions, commit, tag, push (use the cut-release skill to draft notes first). Attaches no store artifacts — they cannot exist until this bump is committed
scripts-info.release:publish: Attach the React Native app's built .aab/.ipa to an existing GitHub Release, refusing any artifact whose embedded version or app ID does not match (run after the cut-release then build skills)
scripts-info.worktrees:salvage: Move gitignored evidence (perf-profiles/, red-team decrypted/output) out of agent worktrees into ~/Code/splotch-worktree-evidence before they are pruned; dry run by default, -- --apply to move (prune-git-workspace skill)
scripts-info.worktrees:prune: Remove agent worktrees that are clean, merged into origin/main, salvaged, and no process's cwd — one removed/kept/skip (in use) line each; dry run by default, -- --apply to remove; never touches the main checkout or any branch
scripts-info.branches:prune: Delete local branches proven dead against origin/main with git branch -d, report why every other one stays (open PR, worktree-held, unique commits); dry run by default, -- --apply to delete, -- --include-equivalent to also delete rebase/squash-merged branches after a verbatim proof. Second form -- --delete-branch=<name> --at=<commit> is the judgment pass's guarded single-branch delete
scripts-info.branches:gather: One row of facts per origin branch (ahead/behind/inbase/age) for the prune-git-workspace skill's remote triage; deletes nothing
scripts-info.check:device-identifiers: Fail when any tracked file contains a physical-device identifier (Apple hardware UDID or rig Android serial shapes), or any tracked file under perf-profiles/evidence/ carries a capture-host address (a private IPv4 or an mDNS .local name) — promoted evidence must carry [redacted] for a device and lan-host / rig-mac.local for a host, and tests the FAKE_* constants from tools/perf/lib/device-identifiers.mjs; output masks matched values (issues 1645 and 2221). Also run as a test by tools/perf/tests/device-identifier-guard.test.mjs in the CI tools tier
scripts-info.check:migration:rsd-drawing-transform: Verify canonical RSD registration and transform actual drawing screen, adapters and released native renderer
scripts-info.test:migration:rsd-selection: Mount the React Native candidate's RSD drawing-screen tests (tools/migration/tests/rsd-native-*.test.mjs) through the released native react-strict-dom renderer with host seams; CI's Browserless tests job runs it on every PR
scripts-info.check:migration:types: Type-check the React Native candidate's own TypeScript project (tsconfig.json), which npm run check does not cover; CI's Quality job runs it on every PR
scripts-info.check:migration:rsd-drawing-tokens: Verify the RSD drawing-screen token projection against the shared design owner
scripts-info.native:web:build: Production web export of the React Native app (expo export --platform web) into dist/web (gitignored), made installable and offline: the shipping web manifest, icons and install head tags plus a Workbox service worker that precaches this build's index.html first under a content-addressed URL, every exported chunk and asset, and the bundled starter coloring book, each entry pinned by subresource integrity so an install racing a deploy fails instead of pairing one build's document with another's chunks; plus a prerendered document for each route-table page with its own (privacy.html, changelog.html, feedback.html, the web-only beta.html) and for the not-found page (404.html), with the page entry bundle they share, the unlinked, noindex admin console (admin.html) with its own React DOM entry and CSS, and the web-only styleguide (design.html) with its own entry and styles, after a guard that fails if the drawing screen's module graph reaches the page entry; index.html's <noscript> links the pages that read without JavaScript
scripts-info.postnative:web:build: Verify the native:web:build service worker and documents: one app shell first, at index.html's content address and used as the offline navigation answer, every entry's integrity equal to the exported bytes, every exported file and every file the shell names precached and present, every bundled Farm page's line art and images precached, index.html and 404.html each opening with a Content-Security-Policy that hashes every inline script and never allows 'unsafe-inline', no lazily loaded icon, page line art or release note in a script the shell loads, and the precache under its byte budget; then hold the app shell's executable inline scripts and inline CSS plus the scripts, stylesheets and script and style preloads its document names to MAX_NATIVE_WEB_FIRST_PAINT_BYTES, and every script and stylesheet the drawing controls wait for (including the bundle a prerendered shell loads after first paint; each URL once) to MAX_NATIVE_WEB_CORE_CONTROLS_BYTES, with no image inlined into them beyond INLINED_IMAGE_EXCEPTIONS; then hold each page document the build writes (privacy.html, changelog.html, feedback.html, beta.html, design.html, 404.html) to its own MAX_NATIVE_WEB_PAGE_BYTES first-paint and page-entry budgets; then load each in Chromium with JavaScript off in every layout and theme, failing unless it reads in full, links what it must, follows its section links into view and opens each canonical section address (a shared /privacy#contact, the footer's /changelog#release-…) on its section, with design.html's stuck contents sidebar inside the window; then drive admin.html in Chromium against the local /api function under a test admin secret (session kept across a reload, codes listed, added and removed, usage figures and free grants read beside them, the session forgotten on a 401 and on sign-out, same-origin bearer writes passing the deployed CSRF guard, the masthead inside a 320 px window); then lay the drawing screen out in Chromium at every safe-area matrix device profile and orientation under that device's real insets (tools/migration/lib/safeAreaMatrix/, docs/SAFE-AREA.md), failing unless the insets reach the app, every control's tap point sits in the claimable region, the page never scrolls, the Notch Band paints the edges diagnose() selects and the coloring picker clears the side insets
scripts-info.gen:native-replay-traces: Write the touch traces the RN perf probe build replays into the paper (perf/replay): the generated ones from a fixed seed, and, with -- --recordings=<dir>, the two finger sessions converted from the web input recordings session1.json and session2.json in that folder
scripts-info.android:accessibility:build: Build the self-targeted RN accessibility-action diagnostic, signed with the local debug key; no install or device input
